title: Get 4 Blocks
description: Get 4 blocks from recipes that require 4 materials.
body:
Data pack: Get 4 blocks from recipes that require 4 materials. 
Current version includes: 
- Bricks 
- Nether Bricks 
- Red Nether Bricks 
- Resin Bricks 
- Quartz Block 
- Sandstone 
- Red Sandstone 

Please let me know if there are any more I should add. Thanks!
